blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO,, Ilocos Sur — Several areas in Vigan City and in five nearby municipalities of Ilocos Sur will experience a power interruption on Nov. 12, from 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. due to upgrading, maintenance and clearing of electrical lines, according to the Ilocos Sur Electric Cooperative Inc. (ISECO). In Vigan City, the affected areas include Solidwest, Pantay Daya, Pantay Fatima, Pantay Laud, the western part of San Pedro, Ayusan Sur, portions of Paoa, Bulala, Paratong, Mindoro, the northern part of Pagburnayan and the western part of Ayusan Norte.
